blockquote.para: This event allows a plugin to provide an instance of an email send provider which overrides the default implementation packaged with MantisBT. The first plugin response is used. If null, then the default provider will be used.

listitem.para: <EmailSender>: The email provider to use or null to use the standard provider.

blockquote.para: This event allows a plugin to specify a set of users to be included as recipients for a notification. The set of users returned is added to the list of recipients already generated from the existing notification flags and selection process.

listitem.para: <Array>: User IDs to include as recipients

blockquote.para: This event allows a plugin to selectively exclude individual users from the recipient list for a notification. The event is signalled for every user in the final recipient list, including recipients added by the event NOTIFY_USER_INCLUDE as described above.

listitem.para: <Boolean>: True to exclude the user, false otherwise

blockquote.para: Triggered when MantisBT is about to notify users of something that happened to an issue, with the users that are notified: the same users as the emails go to, once the preferences of the users and their access to the issue and to the note have been applied. It lets a plugin do something else with the same notifications: an in-app notification, a webhook, a chat message. It is not triggered for the account emails (sign up, password reset).

The event is triggered where the emails are sent, so it is not triggered when $g_enable_email_notification is OFF: MantisBT also turns that setting off to prevent all notifications, for instance while it deletes a project and its issues. A site that wants the event without sending emails can leave email notifications on, and $g_email_send_using_cronjob on, without running the cronjob that sends the queue.

listitem.para: <String>: the notification type: the type of the recipients of an update (new, updated, owner, reopened, deleted, bugnote, ...), mention or reminder
<Array>: the ids of the users that are notified (not their email addresses)
<String|null>: the message identifier of the notification (its title in the language files), null for mentions and reminders
<Integer|null>: the id of the note, when the notification is about a note
<Integer>: the id of the user whose action caused the notification, NO_USER (0) when nobody is logged in, as in scripts
